project_option: Project 2 — Opportunity Registry and Pathway Platform
scope_note: On 2026-11-16 (Toronto), Moodle exposed Project 2 requirements through R3 but no visible R4 requirements chapter or fixture bundle. These checks document verified peer-QA repairs and do not claim an undisclosed R4 feature specification.
verification_status: The local automated suite passed 24/24 checks and the frontend production build passed. After Supabase resumed, the deployed backend health endpoint returned 200 with database reachable. Render deployed branch commit ff3db4d06a803b0cc027aedf11fe53c1986205a8 live; the public page exposed the new Supervised opportunities heading and Sign out control, and GET /api/opportunities returned source_type faculty for O-305. A controlled mutation-enabled deployed QA run has not been performed against production.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: an old-run match cannot be confirmed after renewal
checks.method_or_action: Renew an expired opportunity, then attempt to confirm a match proposal belonging to its previous run.
checks.role: verified faculty and an invited student
checks.setup: Use a disposable/reset R3 fixture copy with an expired opportunity and an invited match from its prior run.
checks.expected_behavior: The old proposal confirmation is rejected, and the new opportunity run remains open rather than becoming matched.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: dates respect the configured evaluation date
checks.method_or_action: Attempt a renewal deadline before the fixture evaluation date and an outcome completion date after that date.
checks.role: verified faculty and a participating student
checks.setup: Use the controlled R3 fixture's configured evaluation date rather than the wall-clock date.
checks.expected_behavior: Both invalid dates are rejected with clear validation errors and no invalid lifecycle state is created.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: faculty-source and industry opportunity rules stay distinct
checks.entry_point: PATCH /api/matches/{matchId}/partner-agreement; deployed faculty and public opportunity cards
checks.method_or_action: Attempt to record a partner agreement for a faculty-source opportunity, then inspect labels and controls for both source types.
checks.setup: Use one faculty-source opportunity and one industry opportunity from a controlled fixture.
checks.expected_behavior: Partner agreement is refused for a faculty-source opportunity and remains available only for industry opportunities; each source type is labelled accurately.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: outcome availability explanations refresh after confirmation and consent
checks.method_or_action: Confirm a completed outcome and record required participant consent, then inspect its safe lifecycle explanation.
checks.role: participating verified faculty and participating students
checks.setup: Use a controlled completed-outcome fixture with all required participants available.
checks.expected_behavior: The current completed run receives an updated public-availability explanation only after the required confirmation, consent, and public-profile conditions are satisfied.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: sign-out clears current and legacy client sessions
checks.method_or_action: Sign in through the passwordless test-mode flow, select Sign out, then refresh the page.
checks.setup: Use an instructor-approved non-production test account.
checks.expected_behavior: Authenticated workspace controls disappear and both sessionStorage and the former localStorage session location are cleared.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: Peer-QA repair: public discovery offers the safe faculty-contact action
checks.method_or_action: Browse public projects or faculty cards and select the faculty-contact action for an eligible public faculty profile.
checks.setup: Use an opportunity or faculty card associated with a public faculty profile.
checks.expected_behavior: The contact action uses the existing safe contact endpoint and exposes no partner contact information.

fixture_setup: Use a disposable or evaluator-controlled R3 fixture database. Apply schema.sql, then use the repository's controlled R1/R2 setup followed by npm --prefix backend run seed:r3. Do not use mutation-enabled fixture seeding or the deployed QA runner against shared production data without explicit authorization and an isolated reset plan.
test_access: Use instructor-approved passwordless test-mode accounts. Provide verified-faculty, invited-student, uninvolved-student, and staff/admin fixture access only through the approved private course channel; do not commit passwords, tokens, challenge codes, or database credentials.
